channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Estudiante universitario llegó a Las Vegas de vacaciones. Terminó deportado.
item.description: El estudiante de 22 años, quien viajó de California para visitar Las Vegas con sus amigos, terminó deportado. Lo anterior surge cuando empleadores locales han expresado preocupación por la agenda migratoria del Presidente Trump, la cual está afectando el turismo.

item.title: Strip gaming, Vegas airport traffic fall sharply in January; trade shows pick up slack
item.description: Casino revenue falls 11 percent, passengers down 8 percent, but a 2.2 percent decline in visitors is considered a win.

item.title: Nevada lawmakers say candidates can use campaign donations to buy guns
item.description: They also approved new rules explaining when non-postmarked mail ballots can be counted, and whether databases can be used to challenge another voter's eligibility.

item.title: More than $130M was allocated for EV charger buildout in Nevada. Few were built.
item.description: Nevada's department of transportation and NV Energy were poised to spend a combined $138 million building electric vehicle charging stations across the state. Five years later, just $12 million has been spent.

item.title: Nevada inmates and families say tablet program is more ‘predatory’ than practical
item.description: Inmate advocates are calling for a boycott of prison communications and tablets every Wednesday starting this week to protest pricing and quality issues.

item.title: OPINION: Sex traffickers Epstein and Nygard lived large in Las Vegas
item.description: Nygard enjoyed the advantage of being in fashion, an industry forever in need of new talent. Epstein was partial to pageants, including the Miss Teen USA Pageant when it was owned by his friend Donald Trump.

item.title: OPINION: We must hold the line against Trump’s false election fraud claims
item.description: Exactly how would this conspiracy have worked? No one ever explained because it would be virtually impossible. Instead of speaking up, Republicans either echoed his fantasies or remained mute, both spineless and damaging reactions.

item.title: Who’s running? Nevada 2026 candidate filing period opens
item.description: The candidate filing period opened Monday and ends March 13.

item.title: Casi 1 de cada 10 lugares gratuitos en preescolar en Nevada están vacantes ¿Por qué?
item.description: El programa preescolar gratuito del estado se está ampliando, pero Nevada todavía tiene un retraso con respecto a otros estados en cuanto a métricas relacionadas con financiamiento escolar, cuidado infantil y preescolar.

item.title: Vegas companies building casinos in UAE on alert after Iran strikes in Dubai
item.description: Wynn and MGM are in close contact with employees there, although the companies’ multibillion-dollar projects were untouched by strikes that hit other hotels.
